A **Baseball Bat** is a melee weapon in *Fallout 76*.

A two-handed lightweight makeshift melee weapon with decent damage but a slow swing speed. It can be modified with a variety of modifications to increase its lethality.

Found baseball bats have a 27.27% chance to be the natural material, 12.12% chance to be Cedar, Oak, or Mahogany, 6.06% chance to be Black, Blue, Grey, or Red, and a 3.03% chance to be All Star, Indigo, Pink, or Yellow.
